muxt generate --use-receiver-type=Server
muxt check

exec go test -race -count=1

-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "GET /mixed sse(Mixed(ctx, send, marshalJSON(sendStatus)))" -}}html:{{- .Result -}}{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- server.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

// Server does not define Mixed: muxt synthesizes both send callbacks as
// func(any) error so template-first iteration exposes the full surface.
type Server struct{}
-- server_test.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

// impl implements the generated receiver interface by hand; compiling this
// method against TemplateRoutes proves both synthesized callback types
// include the per-event options variadic.
type impl struct{}

func (impl) Mixed(_ context.Context, send func(result any, opts ...SSEEventOption) error, sendStatus func(result any, opts ...SSEEventOption) error) {
	_ = send("frag")
	_ = sendStatus(map[string]bool{"ok": true})
}

func Test(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, impl{})

	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/mixed", nil)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)

	body := rec.Body.String()
	if want := "data: html:frag\n\n"; !strings.Contains(body, want) {
		t.Fatalf("body = %q, want the rendered event %q", body, want)
	}
	if want := "data: {\"ok\":true}\n\n"; !strings.Contains(body, want) {
		t.Fatalf("body = %q, want the JSON event %q", body, want)
	}
}
